defs.def: to change your opinions or plans, for example because of sth you have learned 改变，修改（意见或计划）

ex.s: 40   The resulting blank space invites you to revise.
ex.t: 40 由此产生的空白空间邀请你去修改。

ex.s: Many beginning writers don't leave enough space to revise.
ex.t: 许多初级作家没有留下足够的修改空间。

ex.s: General content 4 Get your draft back and revise it.
ex.t: 总内容 4 取回你的草稿并修改。

ex.s: Use the checklist to help each other revise the drafts.
ex.t: 用检查清单互相帮助修改草稿。

ex.s: Use the checklist to help your partner revise his/her draft.
ex.t: 用检查清单帮助你的同伴修改他/她的草稿。

ex.s: Use this checklist to help you revise the draft.
ex.t: 用这个检查清单帮助你修改草稿。

ex.s: Then revise his second diary entry using ellipses when possible.
ex.t: 然后在可能的情况下用省略号修改他的第二篇日记。

ex.s: After you have revised your draft until it is too messy to work from anymore, you can enter your changes into your word processor.
ex.t: 在你的初稿被修改得过于凌乱无法继续使用之后，你可以把修改内容输入文字处理器。

defs.def: to change sth, such as a book or an estimate, in order to correct or improve it 修改，修订（书、估算等）
to prepare for an exam by looking again at work that you have done 复习；温习
